name: cuj-rust compose base verification
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq postgresql-client >/dev/null && psql -h db -U postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "create table seeded(note text); insert into seeded values ('from-build-' || now()::text)" && echo compose-build-ok > .dv-compose-built
postCreateCommand: psql -h db -U postgres -Atc 'select note from seeded' > .dv-compose-task && echo compose-task-ok >> .dv-compose-task
